before.name: Adele Beacham
before.description: Sr. Adele Beacham SP, 76, has been a Sister of Providence for 56 years. Retired at St. Mary of the Woods. Volunteer ministries: Health Care, Secretarial work at our Tutorial House for children and adults, distributing food at a distribution center to families below the national income level. Committee work: I am a member of the Sisters of Providence Liturgy Committee, I am a member of the Day Care Board serving the educational needs of infants and pre-school children. I am also an active member of a Pax Christi Group. Prison ministry - Rockville Correctional Facility - Women's Prison. Sentenced on 1/28/03 to 12 months in home confinement, 250 hours community service. This custody record is documented by the SOA Watch Austin prisoner chronology: https://www.soaw-austin.org/POC1983_2012.php
